newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Sierad Produce to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Sierad Produce to float shares.

text.p: Indonesian agrifood company PT Sierad Produce said on Monday it planned to float some 38.46 percent of its shares on local bourses early next year.
Sierad said 250 million shares at a par value of 500 rupiah each would be listed on the Jakarta and the Surabaya Stock Exchanges on January 10, 1997.
It said 48 percent of the proceeds would be used to fund its expansion programme, 27 percent for working capital and the balance to reduce debts.
PT Lippo Securities has been appointed lead underwriter of the issue and Wheelock NatWest the international coordinator.
Sierad said it posted a net profit of 9.9 billion rupiah in Qthe first five months of this year on sales of 179.9 billion rupiah.
It said net earnings were forecast to hit 27.1 billion rupiah on sales of 398.8 billion rupiah in 1996 and rise again to 76.7 billion rupiah on 778.1 billion rupiah respectively in 1997.
Sierad said the rises would result from expansion of its franchises and feedmill sales.

Sierad Produce was established in 1985 to market chicken and process chicken meat, but it has since diversified into the agrifood sector, with interests ranging from breeding of day-old-chicks to processed food, fast food and restaurants.
